 Data marketer Acxiom has named Gary Laben as chief executive officer, effective immediately. Laben succeeds Jarrod Martin, who established Acxiom’s offering within Omnicom’s integrated media solutions following an acquisition from Interpublic.
 Martin will remain as chief transformation officer at Omnicom Media. Acxiom is headquarterd in Conway, Ark., and has a large corporate presence in Little Rock.
 Laben brings decades of experience transforming global data, technology, and services businesses. He most recently served as CEO of Trax, leading the transformation and sale of the AI-powered retail intelligence company.
 Prior to Trax, Laben was CEO of Dynata, where he led the formation of the world’s largest first-party data and insights platform. He also was global chief data officer of Wunderman and CEO of KBM Group, creating data and technology solutions to streamline their global agency strategy, creative and media processes.
 Gary Laben. 
 His earlier leadership roles included Experian, TRW, and Dun & Bradstreet.
 “Acxiom has long been the gold standard for responsible data management and identity resolution, driving the convergence of identity, data, technology and marketing innovation for the AI era,” said John Wren, Omnicom chairman and CEO. “Real ID is foundational to Omni, helping our teams better understand consumers and deliver stronger integrated media outcomes for our clients. Gary has spent his career building and transforming global data, identity and technology businesses, making him the right person to build on Acxiom’s already strong capabilities.”
 “At this pivotal moment for connected, enterprise data, we have a critical opportunity to help brands create foundations they can own and immediately activate for AI-powered decisioning. I’m thrilled to lead the Acxiom team to supercharge our offerings and advance the full power of Real ID within Omni, ensuring it serves as the undisputed intelligence engine driving precise, personalized consumer interactions for Omnicom’s clients,” said Laben.
 Omnicom (NYSE: OMC), which owns Acxiom, is a leading marketing and sales company globally.
